reason: My PSA reports and finance person already show me which agreements lose money, and I review the big clients quarterly anyway. I might run the free audit out of curiosity, but I'm not committing £499 a month for a tool that tells me what I mostly already know.
objection: Uploads only means my team spends time exporting CSVs and contract PDFs every month, and £4,281 over six months on a 15-client demo tells me nothing about what it finds at my size that my own reporting misses. 'Potential leakage' with confidence levels sounds like a list I'd have to argue with my account managers about.
would_change_my_mind: If the free audit on my own data turned up recoverable money my PSA reports didn't catch, at least ten times the monthly fee, with ticket and contract evidence my team could actually bill against.
